settings.question: How long do your fragrances last?
settings.answer: Our eaux de parfum are composed at a high concentration for long wear — up to 12 hours depending on the scent and your skin type. Apply to pulse points and moisturized skin for best results.

settings.question: Are your fragrances unisex?
settings.answer: Yes — every XplorScent composition is designed to be worn by anyone. We build scents around character and mood, not categories.

settings.question: Do you offer samples or testers?
settings.answer: Yes — the Discovery Spray Set brings all five signature fragrances in 3 mL travel sprays, so you can find your scent before committing to a full bottle.

settings.question: What's the difference between the perfumes and the mists?
settings.answer: The eaux de parfum carry each signature at full depth for up to 12 hours. The hair & body mists are the same signatures at an airy concentration — refreshable, gentle on hair, up to 6 hours of wear. The Mist & Fragrance Sets pair the two.

settings.question: How should I store my fragrance?
settings.answer: Keep bottles away from direct sunlight and heat — a cool, dark shelf preserves the composition for years.

settings.question: Where do you ship?
settings.answer: We ship worldwide. Once your order is on its way you'll receive a confirmation email with a tracking number. Shipping costs and delivery times vary by destination.

settings.question: How quickly will my order ship?
settings.answer: Orders are dispatched within 1–2 business days with tracked delivery.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: Unopened items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Write to us at support@xplorscent.com and we'll arrange everything.

settings.question: Is my payment secure?
settings.answer: Yes — checkout is handled by Shopify's encrypted payment infrastructure. We never see or store your card details.
